description: A nested, non-root `$id` directly on `not`'s own subschema: Python's `validator.evolve(schema=...).is_valid(...)` (`not`/`if`/`contains`'s own building block) never calls `descend()` for that schema, the only place a `$id` subresource scope is pushed, so the `$ref` inside it still resolves against the parent document's own `$defs`, not the nested `$id`'s own base. `a: "x"` makes the inner schema valid, so `not` itself reports `schema_invalid`.
